Company Drivers Program

CDL-A Dry Van OTR Drivers

Enjoy stability, respect, and high earning power. At HILS Trucking LLC, we treat our drivers as true partners with honest weekly settlements and top-tier equipment.

$2,500/Wk Guarantee or 32% Gross

Never worry about slow weeks. You get a solid $2,500 guaranteed safety net every week. When your gross exceeds $7,800, your 32% cut pays you even more (average driver gross is $8,000+ per week).

Average Pay: $2,500 – $3,200+/week

0% Deposits & No Hidden Fees

We do not hold your money hostage. Zero escrow deposits, zero administrative deductions, and zero mystery charges. What you earn is what you take home on direct deposit.

Direct Deposit Every Friday

100% Rate Transparency

Complete honesty on every load. We forward the original broker Rate Confirmation (RC) and show open factoring statements. You always know exactly what the broker pays.

Original Broker RC Provided

Driver & Dispatch Teamwork

No forced dispatch! We collaborate directly with our drivers. We provide direct access to DAT Power load board so you can participate in choosing lanes and loads that suit you.

DAT Load Board Access

TA & Petro Fuel Cards

Convenient fueling across the nationwide TA and Petro network with fleet fuel cards, ensuring smooth stops, driver shower points, and hassle-free OTR travel.

Nationwide Fuel Network

Flexible Schedule & Home Restarts

We value your family time and work-life balance. Flexible schedules designed around your lifestyle, with planned home 34-hour restarts to keep you refreshed.

Home Restarts Guaranteed

Qualifications

Driver Requirements

We maintain high standards to protect our safety rating and ensure a smooth, professional driving experience.

Company Drivers (CDL-A)

  • ✓
    Valid CDL Class A license issued in the United States.
  • ✓
    Minimum 1+ years of verifiable Class A OTR driving experience.
  • ✓
    Clean MVR record — no major moving violations, suspensions, or DUIs within the past 5 years.
  • ✓
    Current Medical Card (DOT Physical) in good standing.
  • ✓
    Ability to pass pre-employment DOT drug screening & Clearinghouse check.
  • ✓
    Responsible attitude toward equipment care and safety regulations.

Owner-Operators

  • ✓
    Valid CDL Class A license & verifiable OTR experience.
  • ✓
    Tractor in good working condition passing current annual DOT inspection.
  • ✓
    ELD-compliant equipment installed (or compatible hardware).
  • ✓
    Clean safety history and adherence to FMCSA driving hours.
  • ✓
    Dry Van trailer available, or rent our late-model 2023+ Utility trailers.
  • ✓
    Valid DOT Medical Card & Clearinghouse compliance.
